get.description:
Response rows carry two independent signals, do not conflate them:
`isGenerated` is true only when the item sits on an AP with `Status == Generated`;
it says nothing about Draft APs holding the item.
`takenByCode` is the Code of whichever AP (Draft or Generated) currently holds the item,
or null if it is genuinely free. `takenByCode == null` is the selectability signal an
item can be picked; `isGenerated == false` alone does NOT mean an item is free, it may
still be sitting on someone else's Draft AP (non-null `takenByCode`).
When `includeGenerated=false`, every returned row already has `takenByCode == null`
by construction (taken items are filtered out before the response is built).
PO and AP hold items in independent pools: an item on a Draft PO is still selectable here.
